SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. P. REGISTRY
3949
18 / 8 / 32

Extract of Daily Intelligence Report dated 18/8/32

Raid on Communist Base

Acting on the authority of a search warrant
issued at the request of the Shanghai Public Safety
Bureau, the Municipal Police searched the front upstairs
room of No.88 Peng Yoong Faung, Ward Road, at 12.05 p.m.
August 17. A communist draft containing the principles
of propaganda in connection with the September 18
Anniversary (Japanese occupation of Manchuria) and
advocating the establishment of Soviet rule in China,
together with a quantity of pro-communist books in
Chinese and Japanese, were seized. The occupant of
the room named Tong Yah Ming (匡亚明) was absent at
the time of raid.

An application will be made to the Court on
August 18 for disposal of the seized literature.

Reg. Passed to You.
JSR 18/8

1932年8月18日

1932年8月18日每日情报报告摘录

突袭共产党据点

根据应上海公共安全局请求签发的搜查令授权，市政警察于8月17日下午12时05分搜查了华德路彭永坊88号的前楼房间。查获一份关于“九一八”纪念日（日本占领满洲）宣传原则并主张在中国建立苏维埃政权的共产党草案，以及一批中文和日文的亲共书籍。房间住客匡亚明（Tong Yah Ming）在突袭时不在场。

将于8月18日向法庭申请处置查获的宣传品。

登记。转交给你。
JSR 8月18日

At 12.30 p.m. 17/8/32 D.S. Prokofiev of the
Special Branch came to the station accompanied by
members of the Bureau of Public Safety. He brought
with him a warrant issued by the S.S.D.Court authoris-
ing the search of No. 88 Woo Yue Fong, Ward Road for
communistic literature and one for the arrest of one
Kuhang Sing (匡姓) occupant of an upstairs room at
that address, who was suspected of possessing this
literature. Detectives from Yulin Road Station accom-
panied the party to the above address but found that
the occupant of the room was not on the premises.

In the room were found a large number of books.
These were taken to the station where they were examined
by detectives of the Special Branch who declared twenty-
five of them to be of a communistic nature. In one of
the drawers was found a written draft of a pamphlet in
Chinese entitled :- "General Principles of Propaganda
in connection with the anniversary of 18th September
(Japanese occupation of Manchuria)!

1932年8月17日下午12时30分，特别分部侦探长普罗科菲耶夫（Prokofiev）在公共安全局成员陪同下来到警署。他带来了一份由特区法院签发的搜查令，授权搜查华德路吴越坊88号以查找共产主义文献，以及一份逮捕该地址楼上房间住客 Kuhang Sing（匡姓）的逮捕令，此人涉嫌持有上述文献。榆林路警署的侦探随同前往上述地址，但发现房间住客不在屋内。

在房间内发现大量书籍。这些书籍被带回警署，经特别分部侦探检查，其中二十五本被认定为具有共产主义性质。在一个抽屉里发现了一份中文小册子的手写草案，题为：“关于‘九一八’纪念日（日本占领满洲）的宣传总纲！”

List of Pre-communist books seized from No. 88 Pang Yoong
Road, Yulin Road (Yulin Road District) at 12.00 p.m.
August 17th, 1931.

1. Communist draft entitled "General principles of propaganda
in connection with the September 18th Anniversary (the Japanese
occupation of Manchuria)", suggesting the establishment of
Soviet Rule in China. (Translation attached)

2. One set "History of China's Revolutions from 1925 to 1927".

3. "The Red Monthly", Issue No. 1, two copies; Issue No. 2, 1 copy;
March Anniversary Issue, 1 copy.

4. "Soviet Critic", issue No. 3. One copy.

5. "Poo Loo Monthly", one copy.

6. "History of Cultural Revolutions in the West", one copy.

7. "China Labour Problem".

8. "The Economic Principles of Marx", one copy.

9. "The General World Situation", One copy.

10. "Theory and Practice of China's Social Problems", one copy.

11. "Diary of a New Russian Student", one copy.

12. "Historic Materialism", one copy each, part 2 and part 3.

13. "Soviet Criticisms", one copy.

14. "Tah-Kim-Woo-Lai-Sun's Book on the Bolshevik's Literal
Methods", one copy.

15. "Agitation and Social Life", one copy.

16. "Fundamental Problems of Marxism", one copy.

17. "Soviet Literature and Theories", one copy.

18. "History of China's Revolutionary Movement", one copy.

19. "Modern Youth", Issue No. 1, one copy.

20. "Agitation and Counter-Revolution" or "Learning in 1930", one
copy.

Translation of a draft entitled "Principles of Propaganda
in connection with the September 18th Anniversary (The
Invasion of Manchuria by Japan)," found at No. 1896 Feng Yoong
Faung (鸿运坊), Ward Road (Yulin Rd District), at 12.05 p.m.
August 17, 1932.

In order to facilitate an attack upon Soviet Russia,
to suppress China's revolution which is developing, and to
partition China, the Japanese Imperialists occupied
Manchuria on September 18, 1931, with the assistance of the
Imperialists of various countries. The occupation was
carried out without sacrifice on the part of the Japanese
forces as a result of the non-resistance policy of the
Kuomintang which is betraying our national rights.

Despite the disagreement among the Imperialists over the
Manchurian problem, they have united in the struggle against
Soviet Russia and the Chinese Red Armies, and are determined
to partition China. In doing so, they expect to save
themselves.

The social reconstruction of Soviet Russia has proved
to be successful, the Chinese Red Armies and Soviet districts
are developing, and the revolutionary movements in various
foreign countries will soon ripen. In China, we have
100,000,000 people who are Reds, and 300,000 Red troops.
More than 300 Hsiens have been transformed into Soviet Districts
where labourers, peasants, and poor people enjoy political
dictatorship. In Germany, the communists are gaining
victories in the election; and in other countries the number
of the unemployed is on the increase. Threatened by all
these events, the imperialists deem it necessary to
accelerate their attack upon Soviet Russia, the partition of
China, and suppression of the Chinese Red Armies so as to
establish a Fascist dictatorship. They menace labourers
and peasants and instigate their allies, the Kuomintang and
pages.zh:
1932年8月17日下午12时05分，在华德路鸿运坊1896号（榆林区）发现的题为“关于‘九一八’纪念日（日本入侵满洲）的宣传原则”草案的译文。

为了便于进攻苏俄，镇压正在发展的中国革命，并瓜分中国，日本帝国主义者在各帝国主义国家的协助下，于1931年9月18日占领了满洲。由于出卖国家权利的国民党采取不抵抗政策，日军在未付出牺牲的情况下完成了占领。

尽管帝国主义者在满洲问题上存在分歧，但他们联合起来对抗苏俄和中国红军，并决心瓜分中国。他们指望以此自救。

苏俄的社会重建已被证明是成功的，中国红军和苏维埃区正在发展，各国的革命运动即将成熟。在中国，我们有1亿红色群众和30万红军士兵。300多个县已转变为苏维埃区，工人、农民和贫民享有政治专政。在德国，共产党人在选举中取得胜利；在其他国家，失业人数不断增加。受到所有这些事件的威胁，帝国主义者认为有必要加速进攻苏俄、瓜分中国和镇压中国红军，以便建立法西斯独裁统治。他们威胁工人和农民，并唆使他们的盟友国民党和

pages.en:
-2-

the Elimination Clique, to spread rumours against the
revolutionalists.

The shameless Kuomintang is entreating the
League of Nations to help in connection with the
Manchurian problem. This is simply to cover up its
betrayal of our national rights. However, the vast
Chinese labouring and peasant masses are well aware of the
treachery of the Kuomintang and of the League of Nations
which is the mouthpiece of the Imperialists for the
partition of China and the attack upon Soviet Russia.
The League of Nations instigated the September 18th incident
(the occupation of Manchuria by Japan).

Instead of reinforcing the volunteer armies who are
fighting the Japanese forces in the North East or the
19th Route Army when it was fighting the Japanese troops
in Shanghai, the Kuomintang militarists have concentrated
their attention to the massacre of Chinese labouring and
peasant masses. Therefore, in order to effect the
emancipation of the Chinese nation we must overthrow
landlords, capitalists, and the Kuomintang and establish
Soviet political rule.

At the instigation of the Imperialists, the Kuomintang
has mobilised 1,000,000 soldiers to attack the Red Armies
by means of cruel weapons such as aeroplanes, cannons, and
poisonous gas. On the other hand, it remains indifferent
towards the Japanese occupation of Manchuria and has failed
to appreciate the services of the Volunteer Army who are
fighting desperately against the Japanese forces in Manchuria.

Despite the strenuous efforts made by the Kuomintang
to suppress Communism, the victory of the Red Armies in
pages.zh:
-2-

改组派散布反对革命者的谣言。

无耻的国民党正乞求国际联盟在满洲问题上提供帮助。这仅仅是为了掩盖其出卖国家权利的行为。然而，广大的中国工农群众充分认识到国民党和国际联盟的背叛行径，后者是帝国主义瓜分中国和进攻苏俄的喉舌。国际联盟煽动了“九一八”事变（日本占领满洲）。

国民党军阀没有增援在东北与日军作战的义勇军，也没有增援在上海与日军作战的第十九路军，而是集中注意力屠杀中国工农群众。因此，为了实现中华民族的解放，我们必须推翻地主、资本家和国民党，建立苏维埃政治统治。

在帝国主义的唆使下，国民党动员了100万士兵，利用飞机、大炮和毒气等残酷武器进攻红军。另一方面，它对日本占领满洲漠不关心，未能表彰在满洲与日军殊死搏斗的义勇军的功绩。

尽管国民党竭力镇压共产主义，但红军的胜利在

pages.en:
-3-

certain as the revolutionary movement of the masses is
developing rapidly and that new Soviet districts have been
Kwangtung
established in Kwangtung and Anhwei.

In commemorating the September 18th Anniversary
(Japanese occupation of Manchuria) we should accelerate
labour struggles, support the volunteer armies in the North
East, conduct propaganda on behalf of the Red Armies and
Soviet Russia, organise "Red Army Friendly Societies" and
"Soviet Friendly Societies," and mobilise workers into
the ranks of the Red Armies.

Shanghai Eastern District Propaganda
Department, August 18th.

是确定的，因为群众革命运动正在迅速发展，且在广东和安徽建立了新的苏维埃区。

在纪念“九一八”纪念日（日本占领满洲）之际，我们应加速劳工斗争，支持东北义勇军，开展拥护红军和苏俄的宣传，组织“红军之友社”和“苏维埃之友社”，并动员工人加入红军队伍。

上海东区宣传部，8月18日。
